brute_force.description: Adversary attempts to gain access by systematically trying many passwords or credentials.

impossible_travel.description: Compromised credentials used from geographically impossible locations within a short time window.

credential_stuffing.description: Adversary uses lists of compromised credentials to attempt access across many accounts.

lateral_movement.description: Adversary moves through the environment by accessing resources outside their normal scope.

device_spoofing.description: Adversary uses a different device or spoofed device fingerprint to access resources.

low_and_slow.description: Adversary gradually increases data access volume and session duration to exfiltrate data below detection thresholds.

insider_drift.description: Legitimate user's behavioral profile gradually shifts, indicating potential insider threat or account compromise.
